$comment: Pinned Studio protocol wire text (PRD FR-GATE-002; research 05 addendum A8). backend/studio/constants.py and ui/src/lib/wire.ts are both tested for byte equality against this file; docs/design/architecture.md §3.1 and docs/design/contracts.md §1.1/§3.4 are derived from it. Casing is load-bearing: the stage gate and plan approval use 'Request Changes'; the summary confirmation uses 'Request changes'.

constants.WIRE_ANSWER_MODE_CHAT_NOTE: Studio answer mode: this reply also answers how this person would like to answer the questions: Chat. Record Chat for that question in its own answer call first, then the answers in this reply right after it. Log no decision for the questions in the file: they were asked there, and a question logged after this reply leaves its answers unrecorded.
constants.WIRE_AUDIT_GROUPED_ANSWER_SUFFIX: Studio grouped-answer delivery: this is one human reply to the questions you asked together, in the order you asked them. Record all Q<n> answers together in ONE aidlc-log.ts answer --details call, preserving their text. Then continue the stage.
constants.WIRE_PREPARE_COMMIT: Please prepare a commit for the current AI-DLC changes. Do not push.
constants.WIRE_GROUPED_ANSWER_SUFFIX: Studio grouped-answer delivery: this is one human reply. Apply each Q<n> answer to its matching [Answer] tag; an X. Other answer is the person's own words, so write X. and those words verbatim, never another option's letter. Record all Q<n> answers together in ONE aidlc-log.ts answer --details call, preserving their text; do not record separate answer receipts for each question. Then present the next human checkpoint and wait.

decisions.answers.single: <letter>. <label> | <letter>, <letter>... — <letter>. <label>; <letter>. <label>... | X. <Other label>: <free text> (an audit question: <label>[, <label>...] | <free text>)
decisions.answers.grouped: Q<n>: <answer>\nQ<m>: <answer> + WIRE_GROUPED_ANSWER_SUFFIX (file-backed group; one audit receipt)
decisions.answers.answer_mode: <answer> + WIRE_ANSWER_MODE_CHAT_NOTE, or Q<n> lines + WIRE_ANSWER_MODE_CHAT_NOTE + WIRE_GROUPED_ANSWER_SUFFIX (file questions while the engine's mode question is open)
decisions.prepare_commit: Please prepare a commit for the current AI-DLC changes. Do not push.

golden.request_changes_example: Request Changes: The acceptance criteria for C3 are not covered.
golden.grouped_answers_example:
Q1: B. Aurora, with read replicas
Q2: A, B — A. Lint; B. Unit tests, fast ones only
Q3: X. Other (please specify): Use the existing worker queue.

Other answer is the person's own words, so write X. and those words verbatim, never another option's letter. Record all Q<n> answers together in ONE aidlc-log.ts answer --details call, preserving their text; do not record separate answer receipts for each question. Then present the next human checkpoint and wait.
